consumer: The NPC trade/talk interaction reached via game::npc_menu -> 'Talk' -> the trading dialogue, which PRESENTS an interactive menu and, on confirmation, PERFORMS the give/take item transfers that mutate both the avatar's and the NPC's inventories.
scope: not applicable as an inventory read; the consumer is the active input loop driving an interactive trade menu/dialogue (the avatar's carried items and the NPC's offered items are operands of the menu, not the authority)
decisive_source: src/game.cpp::game::npc_menu builds a uilist (Talk/Steal/etc.) and calls amenu.query(); the 'Talk' branch enters the NPC dialogue/trade UI driven through the engine's real input loop. The export functions (write_carried_items, write_entities items) only SHOW item state and cannot effect a trade.
divergence: Pick a shopkeeper and an item: a correct answer drives the trade menu so the given item leaves the avatar AND appears in the NPC's inventory while the received item moves the other way, with currency/value balancing applied by the dialogue; a wrong answer that merely edited the carried_items/ground-items snapshot would show the avatar's item gone but the NPC never gained it (no reciprocal transfer, no value check) -- the menu was never queried.
